crossRefs.note: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

translations.web: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
translations.bsb: But the men inside reached out, pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
translations.kjv: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
translations.asv: But the men put forth their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
